name: Smart Contact Manager
summary: Smart Contact Manager is a secure web application that allows users to store, organize, search, update, and manage their personal contacts in one place. The application provides authentication, profile management, contact image uploads, and password recovery while ensuring that each user's contacts remain private and secure.
problem_statement: Managing personal contacts across notebooks, spreadsheets, or multiple devices is inconvenient and can lead to data loss or disorganization. There was a need for a secure platform where users could access and manage their contacts anytime while ensuring data privacy.
objective: To build a secure contact management application with user authentication, contact organization, profile management, and password recovery using modern backend technologies.
my_role: I designed and developed the complete backend using Spring Boot, implemented Spring Security for authentication and authorization, designed the MySQL database schema, developed CRUD functionality for contacts, integrated image upload, implemented OTP-based password recovery, and connected the frontend with backend services.

security.authorization: Authenticated users can only access their own contacts.

workflow: User logs in securely using Spring Security.
Authenticated users can create, update, delete, and search contacts.
Users can upload profile images for contacts.
Forgot password functionality generates an OTP for password reset.
Only the owner of a contact can access or modify it.
challenges: Ensuring users could only access their own contacts.
solutions: Configured Spring Security with custom authentication.
Used BCrypt to encrypt user passwords.
Validated uploaded files before storing them.
Separated business logic into the service layer.
Tested all APIs and application flows thoroughly.
learning_outcomes: Learned secure authentication using Spring Security.
Gained practical experience with Hibernate and JPA.
Strengthened debugging and backend development skills.
future_improvements: Develop REST APIs for mobile applications.
Cloud image storage using AWS S3 or Cloudinary.
Import and export contacts using CSV or Excel.
Deploy the application on cloud platforms.
resume_description: Developed a secure contact management application using Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate, Thymeleaf, and MySQL with authentication, CRUD operations, image upload, and OTP-based password recovery.
